back: A mid-latitude low-pressure system where warm and cold air masses meet, bringing cloud, wind and rain.
Polar front → wave → mature (warm sector between warm and cold fronts) → occlusion → decay.
Gentle slope: cirrus → altostratus → nimbostratus; long steady rain; pressure falling; temperature rises after it passes.
Steep slope: cumulonimbus, short heavy rain, gusts, sudden temperature fall; pressure rises after it passes.
Mild, humid air with low stratus and drizzle; pressure steady.
The faster cold front catches the warm front and lifts the warm air off the ground.
High pressure, sinking air, light winds; settled weather; frost and fog on winter nights.
North-west Europe all year; Mediterranean lands, south-western Cape and south-west Australia in winter.
Lows: clockwise inward. Highs: anticlockwise outward. Depressions move west to east.
